layoutRules: Logo (KAAE_Guidelines4.pdf pp.3-6): clear space on every side equals the height of the "K" in the logo; minimum width 80px digital, 20mm print, 16px favicon with the simplified mark only. Use the original files from the brand team, unchanged.

Light first (pp.1-15): white pages (#FFFFFF) with generous margins; Cream (#FDF8F3) only as a card tint. KAAE Blue (#4770A3, Pantone 5415 C) for titles, the italic lead, the letter-spaced section label and brand cards; KAAE Gold (#F7B500, Pantone 7549 C) for the title bar, the gold part of the header rule, card edges and numbers on navy (p.7). Body text is Midnight (#0A1628); white on KAAE Blue or navy. Extended colours Royal (#1E3A5F), Ocean (#2C5282), Sky (#4A90E2) and Sun (#FFD700) support them (p.8). Gold is never text on white or cream.
Gradients (p.7): KAAE Blue to Gold for the rule at the foot of a page; Gold to Sun for the title bar; KAAE Blue to Midnight for a cover.

Typography: titles in Crimson Pro Bold (a bold old-style serif) in KAAE Blue; leads in Inter Italic in KAAE Blue; body in Inter in Midnight. Sorani and Arabic (p.10): right-aligned, titles in a bold sans (IBM Plex Sans Arabic or Noto Sans Arabic) in KAAE Blue, body in Noto Sans Arabic in Midnight.

Page grammar: logo top-left; a letter-spaced KAAE Blue section label top-right over a thin grey rule whose left part is a gold gradient segment; a serif KAAE Blue title with a short gold gradient bar under it (under its right end in Sorani); an italic KAAE Blue lead; Inter body; rounded cards (white with a soft shadow, KAAE Blue with white text and a Sun or gold card title, or a cream tint with a gold left edge); stat cards with big serif numbers; the KAAE Blue to Gold gradient rule at the foot.
Covers: a navy gradient from KAAE Blue at the top left to Midnight, the logo centred, a white serif title, a short gold bar and a gold letter-spaced subtitle.
Elements (p.13): a quarter-disc sunburst with five rays and a triangle mosaic pattern fading upward, subtle and never over copy or the logo's clear space.
Maintain strict RTL layout symmetry for Kurdish (Sorani) and Arabic communications, ensuring bidirectional numerals preserve institutional dates accurately.

Stationery (p.11): business cards carry the logo, name, title and contact details in the guideline's palette and type; letterheads carry the logo at the top and contacts in the footer; certificates carry the logo, recipient name, seal and date; email signatures carry name, title, KAAE affiliation, phone, email, website and social links.
Photographic imagery must portray authentic students, faculty, and academic review sessions rather than generic commercial stock.
